message.content: {"summary":"Bug introduced by changing unit price representation from cents to dollars without adjusting calculation semantics","findings":[{"file":"src/demo/Checkout.java","evidence":"        return (int) (PriceCatalog.unitPrice() * quantity);","line":10,"severity":"MEDIUM","explanation":"The method totalInCents() now returns dollars truncated to integer instead of actual cents. Before: unitPriceInCents() returned 1250 (cents), so 1250*quantity gave correct cent values. After: unitPrice() returns 12.50 (dollars), so (int)(12.50*quantity) gives dollar amounts truncated to integers, not cents. For quantity=1: before returned 1250 cents ($12.50), after returns 12 (which is $12, not $12.50). This produces incorrect monetary calculations in ordinary use."}]}
